sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(month=0)-SUM(month=9) AS REAL)*100/SUM(month=0) FROM longest_absense_from_school
SELECT T1.name FROM unemployed T1 JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name JOIN longest_absense_from_school T3 ON T3.name=T1.name JOIN male T4 ON T4.name=T1.name WHERE T3.month=5
SELECT COUNT(T2.name) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 LEFT JOIN male T2 ON T2.name=T1.name
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name) FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 LEFT JOIN disabled T2 ON T2.name=T1.name
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T3.name) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled T1 JOIN enlist T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T3 ON T3.name=T1.name WHERE T1.school='ucla' AND T2.organ='air_force'
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.school='uci' AND T3.name IS NULL,1,0)) AS REAL)/COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled T1 JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T3 ON T3.name=T1.name
